UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Stores user-specific data like search stats, draft bills, custom branches, and role permissions.

branchCode.description: Branch code assigned to the officer.

branchName.description: Branch name assigned to the officer.

lastSearchDate.description: ISO string of the last search date.

billDraft.description: JSON stringified array of draft bill items.

customBranches.description: JSON stringified map of custom user branches.

SavedBill.title: SavedBill
SavedBill.description: A bill saved by the user.

id.description: Unique identifier for the saved bill.

items.description: JSON stringified array of bill items.

totalAmount.description: Total amount calculated for this bill.

note.description: Optional note attached to the bill.

trackingId.description: Unique verification tracking code for the bill.

status.description: Current lifecycle status of the bill.

createdAt.description: ISO string of when the bill was created.

updatedAt.description: ISO string of when the bill was last updated.

BranchSubmission.title: BranchSubmission
BranchSubmission.description: Bill submitted by branch officers for verification, consolidation, and date-range reporting.

autoVoucherNo.description: Unique automated system voucher number (e.g. SLI-VCH-2026-9812).

officerName.description: Name of the officer who incurred or submitted the expense.

officerPhone.description: Contact phone number of the officer.

category.description: Expense category (e.g. office rent, electricity, stationery, travel).

voucherNo.description: Optional memo or receipt voucher number.

voucherAttachment.description: Base64 encoded data URI of the uploaded memo/voucher receipt (image or PDF).

voucherFileName.description: Original file name of the uploaded voucher/challan document.

voucherFileType.description: MIME type of the uploaded voucher attachment.

voucherAttachments.description: JSON stringified array of multiple voucher attachments.

returnReason.description: Correction instruction when returned to branch.

approvedBy.description: Name or email of the approving authority.

history.description: JSON stringified array of digital audit approval trail.

submittedByUid.description: Optional UID of the user who submitted the bill.

AuditLog.title: AuditLog
AuditLog.description: Immutable digital record of every creation, modification, approval, and rejection action.

AppNotification.title: AppNotification
AppNotification.description: Real-time updates and alerts for bill submissions and approvals.

/users/{userId}.description: User profiles containing search stats, drafts, and role assignments.

/users/{userId}/savedBills/{billId}.description: Saved bills belonging to the user.

/branch_submissions/{submissionId}.description: Direct bill submissions from branches and field officers.

/audit_logs/{logId}.description: Tamper-evident audit trail of bill modifications and approvals.

/notifications/{notificationId}.description: Notification broadcasts for status changes and approvals.
